items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Frank Burnett? Did you ever know him, Frank Burnett? ... [INTERVIEWEE] They had so many.

ctx.x: He was a guitar player. Yeah, he was a guitar player. No, I can't think of him. What about Frank Burnett? Did you ever know him, Frank Burnett? He was a drummer? Might have been before you...
